# talibcompat

```go
import "github.com/cinar/indicator/v2/internal/talibcompat"
```

Package talibcompat contains tests that compare the library's indicators against TA\-Lib, which serves as the reference implementation for indicator math.

The reference values are produced by testdata/generate.py, which is the only part of the comparison that needs TA\-Lib. The tests read the generated CSV files and use only the standard library, so the module stays free of external dependencies.

Two datasets are compared: a random walk whose prices practically never repeat, and one rounded to a 0.5 tick so that equal highs, lows and closes occur, which exercises tie handling.

Each test case maps a Go indicator, built with its default constructor, to the TA\-Lib columns computed with the same parameters. Where the library intentionally uses a different unit \(a ratio instead of a percentage\) or a different EMA seeding, the case records that explicitly. Where the library currently differs from TA\-Lib, the case is skipped with a link to the issue that tracks it; resolving the issue means removing the skip.

The checks themselves live in talibcompat\_test.go; this file exists only so the package has a non\-test source file for tooling \(e.g. gomarkdoc\) that expects one.
